name: Install the Functions and CLI runtime
Install the rules test client runtime
Verify the test client runtime
run:
node -e 'const [major, minor] = process.versions.node.split(".").map(Number); if (major !== 24 || minor < 12) throw new Error("Rules tests require Node 24.12+")'
echo "KPKN_RULES_NODE=$(command -v node)" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

name: Run Functions on Node 22 and rules tests on Node 24
run:
export PATH="$(dirname "$KPKN_FUNCTIONS_NODE"):$PATH"
"$KPKN_FUNCTIONS_NODE" node_modules/firebase-tools/lib/bin/firebase.js emulators:exec --project demo-kpkn-stability --only firestore,auth,storage,functions "cd functions && \"$KPKN_RULES_NODE\" --test --test-concurrency=1 integration/*.test.mjs"
